title: SDET
intro: I design, build and test automation in Python and PowerShell, covering failure paths, API integrations and web application security.

groups.title: Test Automation & Quality Engineering
bullets: Owned the design, build and testing of Python and PowerShell automation for **2 years** in a **24x7** operations team processing **30–40 tickets a day (~700 a month)**.
Tested every automation across **3 paths** (success, failure, edge cases) and **4 negative scenarios** (invalid input, missing data, API error, timeout) before production release.
Built failure-path tests for the LLM-based NOC Auto-Responder and a template fallback, keeping the tool at **0 missed alerts** while saving **~12 minutes per alert**.
Validated bulk-operation scripts with dry runs, logging and rollback checks, saving **~27 minutes per run** with **0 accounts changed in error**.

groups.title: API & Integration Testing
bullets: Tested end-to-end integrations across **4 enterprise platforms** (ServiceNow, CrowdStrike, Google SecOps, Entra ID), verifying requests, responses and resulting actions.
Verified data from **3 external sources** (site directory, manager lookup, live weather API) feeding automated notifications, handling bursts of **2–5 alerts at once**.

groups.title: Security Testing (VAPT)
bullets: Supported senior testers on VAPT of live web applications, executing test cases across **10+ OWASP Top 10 classes**, including **6 core attacks** (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, IDOR, SSRF, broken access control).
Logged every defect with **4 artefacts** (severity, reproduction steps, PoC, CWE mapping) and retested **100% of fixes** before closure.
Root-caused recurring production issues to **3 sources**, stopping repeat tickets at the source.

achievements: Cut alert handling from **~15 to ~3 minutes (80% faster)** with a tested Python + Gemini automation tool.
Replaced **~30 minutes of manual work with a ~3-minute script run (90% faster)** for bulk account operations.

bullets: Built and tested web app features on the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js).
Built backend modules with Node.js and MongoDB using OOP principles.
Completed paid usability and feedback tests evaluating websites and applications, providing structured, detailed feedback under platform confidentiality terms.
Completed **25+ tests**, maintaining a consistent quality and completion record.
Built an e-commerce app and tested it end to end: found **13 defects across 10+ OWASP categories**, wrote reproduction steps and PoCs, mapped each to CWE and verified 100% of fixes.
Evaluated the detection model over 15 test rounds to reach **98.5% precision and recall**.
Tested backend and extension across real web forms and AI chat tools.
Production tool with tested fallback logic.
**80% faster** alert handling and zero missed alerts.
